title: Desk rules and their evidence (education only, not advice)
sample: 10 paper calls, all closed (3 wins, 7 losses); any result here is promising or not supported, never proven

rules.rule: Exit at -30% from the entry price (the first real trade after the call)
rules.evidence: Kept Oct 23, 2026. In the exit study every stop filled below its level; single sells sent php, Pumuckel and ship straight through (fills -61.3%, -52.5% and -25.1% below the stop), so the real loss when a stop fails is closer to 50-70%. The two calls named without a stop (php, YAI) lost about 80-86% net as logged.
rules.sizing_note: Size each call assuming a 50-70% real loss on a gap, not 30%.

rules.rule: Take half at 2x; the rest rides the same stop
rules.evidence: Kept Oct 23, 2026. All three wins (Arnaud, DIF, ship) came from the 2x half. ship sold half at 2x, then one sell gapped the rest from about $82k to $17.9k; it still closed +23.7% net.

rules.rule: A dev sell on its own is no longer a kill
rules.evidence: Approved Oct 22, 2026. Winner Arnaud had a flagged creator sell; winner DIF's dev never sold but a bundle-style dump still hit it. MemeSwap: 'a creator sell is not the same as a rug'; Alphalumina makes the same point.

rules.rule: Survival checks must still pass after the dev has exited
rules.threshold: price >= 60% of high, buyers > sellers, holders rising (minute 3 to 5)
rules.evidence: Replaces the dev-sell kill. Not yet tested on a call named under the new wording.

rules.rule: Kill (or exit) on a bundle or consolidation dump
rules.evidence: The stops on DIF's runner and on Pumuckel both began with one wallet selling far more than it bought on the curve. Bitquery: 21% of launches had dev wallets in the launch bundle; bundled wallets often pass tokens to other wallets that sell. Kept Oct 23, 2026.

rules.rule: Log creator extraction (taking out more SOL than they put in); no longer a kill
rules.evidence: Downgraded from a kill to log-only on Oct 23, 2026: the launch checker flagged extraction on 3 of 3 winners (Arnaud, DIF, ship) and 1 of 7 losers (Pumuckel), so as a kill it would have removed every winner. Not measurable on the three token-quoted curves.

rules.rule: Shadow skip if non-creator wallets bought 30%+ of supply in the launch slot
rules.evidence: Cutoff set after calls 1-6 (all four at 30%+ lost). Out of sample (calls 7-10): 1 loser caught (EKO 37.8%), 1 loser missed (Pumuckel 25.8%), 0 winners killed (DIF 7.8%, ship 24.1%). Promising, not proven (n=4 out of sample). From Oct 23, 2026 logged as WOULD-SKIP, not enforced.

rules.rule: Score the share bought in the launch slot plus the next two
rules.evidence: EKO 82.7%, FORM 64.9%, php 59.5% all lost; DIF won at 31.7%. Overlaps heavily with same-slot share.

rules.rule: Shadow skip curves priced in a platform token instead of SOL
rules.evidence: 3 of 3 token-quoted calls lost (GRAIL, YAI, EKO). Tiny sample. From Oct 23, 2026 logged as WOULD-SKIP, not enforced.

rules.rule: Shadow skip launchpad / platform-token stories
rules.evidence: 4 of 4 launchpad or platform stories lost (php, GRAIL, MINE, FORM). Story labels are subjective. From Oct 23, 2026 logged as WOULD-SKIP, not enforced.

rules.rule: Score the dev's past graduations, excluding the coin itself
rules.evidence: Alphalumina out-of-sample: devs with a prior graduation completed later launches at 2.139% vs 0.307%. In these 10 calls it did not separate winners from losers, and two coins' only 'graduation' was themselves.

rules.rule: Score new buyers in the 5 minutes after the call
rules.evidence: Not supported: Pumuckel added 1,130 new buyers and lost; ship added 3 and won.

rules.rule: Name calls only at about $15k-$40k market cap
rules.evidence: Not supported as a separator: the three winners were named at $25.9k, $14.3k and $34.2k, and four of the ten calls were named outside the band. Candidate for deletion at 30 calls.

rules.rule: Filter by time of day
rules.evidence: 1 win in 4 AM calls, 2 wins in 6 PM calls. No clear separation.

rules.rule: Treat direct dev-to-wallet SOL funding as the bundle test
rules.evidence: Found 0 dev-funded buyers on all 10 calls, including the ones with probable bundle dumps. Too narrow to rely on alone; kept as one input.

rules.rule: Stop naming calls after 2 stops or zeros in a day
rules.evidence: Kept Oct 23, 2026. Would have tripped by about 10:22 IST, and again by 20:30 IST if counted per session, before calls 7-10.

rules.rule: Entry price is the first real trade after the call, logged to the second
rules.threshold: first trade after the call timestamp
rules.evidence: Arnaud's, FORM's and Pumuckel's call prices were 16 to 20%+ above anything that traded, so the logged entry could not have been filled. With Arnaud's entry corrected, the exit-set averages move from -20.8 / -25.0 / -19.1% to -17.0 / -22.4 / -12.3%.

rules.rule: Log the peak, the low before the peak, and the real stop fill for every call
rules.evidence: The exit study needed these to compare exit rules; under the current rules, stop fills ranged from 0.2% to 61.3% below the stop level.

rules.rule: Judge rules on average R per call, not win rate
rules.evidence: Win rate hides the size of wins and gap losses: the first 10 calls won 30% against a 50% break-even rate and totalled about -8.0R (average -24.0% net). Every rule change is now compared on average R per call.

rules.rule: Exit at call + 15 minutes if price is at or below entry
rules.evidence: Best of the three exit sets in the exit study: -19.1% average vs -20.8% for current rules (-12.3% vs -17.0% with Arnaud's entry corrected). It changed only one call (MINE, -15.4% vs -32.6%). Logged alongside the 'no clock exit while buys lead' rule.

rules.rule: Flag when RugCheck's largest insider network holds 10%+ of supply
rules.evidence: 4 of 7 losers vs 1 of 3 winners at 10%+. Post-hoc, n=10, and taken from a RugCheck snapshot about 12-24 h after the calls, not at call time. RugCheck's overall score did not separate winners from losers.

rules.rule: 40% trailing stop once a call is up 50%
rules.threshold: exit at 60% of the running peak after +50%
rules.evidence: Worst exit set: -25.0% average, 1 win and 9 losses. Gaps blew straight through the trail: php went from +11.0% to -75.4% and DIF from +32.3% to -26.5%; only ship gained (+127.4%).

rules.rule: Enter only after a 20-40% pullback in the first 15 minutes followed by a new high
rules.evidence: 0 of 10 coins showed the pattern (Arnaud's apparent match was an entry-price artifact), so it would never have triggered.

fields.mode: gate = can block or exit a call; shadow = logged as WOULD-SKIP, never blocks; log-only = recorded, no action; method = how calls are priced, logged or judged
fields.changed: date of the last status change
fields.previous_status: status before that change, if any

notes: Sizing: assume the real loss on a gap through the stop is 50-70%, not 30%.
Judge rules on average R per call, not win rate.
